title: The Night Session
hook: The draft is over the ceiling and it is past midnight. Move the money.
text: Four budget years as the budget committee's rapporteur for the rail budget, alone: in the night session (Bereinigungssitzung) the ministry's draft must fit under the ceiling. Move money between the lines, weigh the auditors' hints, set a qualified block where a report is due, choose a grant or equity for DB, and keep the coalition partner on board; then the year's account shows what the money did.

story.say: It is going to be a long night. Whatever we move, the total has to fit under the ceiling before we go home. And my group has a wish, as you will see.
The auditors have sent their remarks. Read them before you move a single euro.
The last budget of this parliament. What we do not fund tonight, the next coalition inherits.
On the table: the line towards Bergheim is your constituency's project, stage by stage. What is built shows there. What is not, your voters will see as well.

debrief: Which line could not spend its money, and how could you have known in the night session?
Equity for DB is outside the debt brake. Who pays for it in the end?
What did the coalition partner's demand cost the existing network?
